description: This file is a shell script for testing git operations, specifically related to tags, commits, and fetching behaviors. It sets up a git repository, creates commits and tags, and verifies fetch behavior with tag following. It includes setup steps, test scenarios, and cleanup procedures for testing git functionality.

methods.name: get_needs
methods.description: A function that extracts 'want' lines from a git packfile trace, used to verify specific refs are fetched.
